name: adContent
headline: Marketing Science Data and Replication
short_description: Access experimental data and replication codes from a Marketing Science study examining how advertising content influences consumer behavior in a controlled bookstore setting.
author: ilyamorozov

sections.overview:
This skill provides the complete replication package from the 2024 Marketing Science paper "Where Does Advertising Content Lead You? We Created a Bookstore to Find Out" by Morozov and Tuchman. It includes Stata and R code to reproduce all tables and figures, plus raw experimental data from Qualtrics surveys, Google Analytics logs, WooCommerce purchases, and Amazon book redemption records. Researchers can run the batch file to replicate results or work with cleaned datasets at the consumer or event level. The package supports independent verification of findings and enables secondary research using the published experimental dataset.
Replicate tables and figures from the advertising content marketing science paper
Conduct secondary analyses on consumer behavior and advertising effects
Analyze book purchase patterns from experimental bookstore data
Study how product rankings and pricing influence consumer search behavior

